intent: A calm, characterful AI chat thread: document-style assistant replies with code and sources, compact ink user bubbles, a streaming final answer and a working composer.

stack.fonts: font-display (Bricolage Grotesque) for the title, font-sans (Geist) for messages, font-mono (Geist Mono) for metadata and code

layout.frame: stone #e9e3d8 section; window max-w 1040px, 820px tall (100dvh, 620–880px on phones), radius 22px, 1px ring at 8% ink, long soft shadow; full-bleed with no radius below sm
layout.header: 64px; title + mono subtitle left, 44px New thread icon button right; 1px bottom rule
layout.column: max-w 720px centred, 16/32px gutters, 36px between messages, scrolls inside the window and follows the stream while pinned to the bottom
layout.userMessage: right-aligned ink bubble, max-w min(82%, 30rem), radius 18px with 6px bottom-right corner, mono time under it
layout.assistantMessage: no bubble; 28px avatar + name + time byline; content indented 38px from sm; paragraphs, dash-marker lists, code block, sources cards, Copy action
layout.codeBlock: ink panel, radius 14px, 44px caption with language tag, filename and Copy/Copied button; 13px mono at 1.75 leading; scrolls horizontally inside itself
layout.composer: cream card radius 20px; attachment chips, auto-growing textarea (52–208px), toolbar with attach, model label, key hint (md+) and round send button; mono disclaimer under it

color.clay: #b4532a (only accent: caret, list dashes, status dot, send hover, focus ring)

motion.thinking: three 6px dots pulsing opacity 0.25→1, staggered 150ms, for 420ms before the first token
motion.streaming: uneven chunks of 2–6 characters (12% chance of a 10–22 burst) every 18–52ms, occasional 160–340ms pause
motion.caret: clay block 0.5em × 1.05em, opacity 1→0.25→1 over 1.1s, at the live end of a paragraph, list item or code
motion.sources: fade up 6px over 450ms, ease [0.2, 0.8, 0.2, 1], after the stream ends
motion.stop: send button becomes Stop while streaming; stopping freezes text and labels the byline 'stopped'
motion.reducedMotion: render every message complete; no caret, dots or entrances

responsive.mobile: full-bleed window, 16px gutters, 44px touch targets, key hint and disclaimer hidden, assistant content not indented
responsive.sm: framed window with radius and shadow, 32px gutters, content indented 38px under the byline
responsive.md: keyboard hint shows in the composer toolbar

accessibility: message list is role=log; each message is an article labelled 'You said' / '<name> said'
aria-busy on a message while it streams
visually hidden label on the textarea; aria-label on attach, send, stop, copy and new-thread buttons
Enter sends, Shift+Enter inserts a newline, IME composition is respected
send disabled when empty or while streaming
2px clay focus-visible rings with a paper offset

content.thread: A developer asks how to stop a search box firing on every keystroke; Wren answers with a debounce hook, a three-item list and three fictional sources, then streams a short follow-up about pressing Enter early
content.cannedReply: an honest placeholder that quotes the user's message and shows the shape a real answer would take

avoid: grey text that isn't ink at an opacity
